annotations.title: Which copy of the sanctions list

description: Shows which copy of the US Treasury OFAC sanctions list (the SDN list) the checks use: the date Treasury published it, how many entries it holds, when it was copied from Treasury and how many days old that copy is, with a warning if the last daily refresh failed or the copy is more than 14 days old. Takes no input. Use it to tell someone how current a check is.
name: get_sdn_list_meta
title: Which copy of the sanctions list
